note: لہذا is a conclusion connector meaning therefore/thus/hence; labeling it only as an adverb understates its discourse/conjunctive role.
آزاد centrally means free/independent/liberated. 'Universal' is not a normal core meaning and the basic 'free' gloss is missing.
شرکت centrally means participation/participating or association, especially in شرکت کرنا 'to participate'. 'Contribution, role' is too narrow.
چکی is both the noun mill/millstone and a very common feminine completive form of چکنا in constructions such as کر چکی ہے ('has already done'). The source omits this grammatical use entirely.
proposed_english: mill; millstone; has/had already completed (feminine completive form in verb constructions, context-dependent)

note: رہ is the stem/imperative base of رہنا meaning remain/stay/live. 'Content word' is not a POS.
proposed_english: remain; stay; live (stem/imperative base of رہنا)

note: جماعت commonly means group/class/congregation and can mean an organized party/group. 'Army, military' is peripheral and should not lead the entry.
نقصان is a noun meaning loss/harm/damage/disadvantage. The adjective 'harmful' is not the direct lexical meaning.
کافی is a crucial homograph: kāfī means enough/sufficient/quite, while coffee is also کافی. The source teaches only coffee and misses the very frequent quantifier/adjective.
ظاہر means evident/apparent/clear and is also used adverbially in ظاہر ہے / apparently/obviously. Adjective-only POS is incomplete.
proposed_english: apparent; evident; clear; obvious; apparently/obviously (adverbial use)

note: تحریک centrally means movement/campaign/motion/stimulation and can mean a proposal/motion. 'Scheme, project' is not an appropriate core gloss.
شیخ means sheikh, elder, or religious leader/cleric and can be a name/title. 'Stingy' is peripheral/source noise and should not lead the entry.
پور is a noun/suffix of Sanskrit origin meaning town/city/settlement and appears extensively in place names. 'Fortress' is not the appropriate core modern learner gloss.
متعلق means related/connected/attached/concerning and is adjectival/participial; it is not itself a preposition.
حال centrally means condition/state/situation and can mean present/current state. The current gloss should be made more direct for learners.
بجائے is especially used in کے بجائے meaning instead of/in place of. Adverb-only analysis misses the common postpositional construction.
proposed_english: instead; instead of; in place of (especially in کے بجائے)

note: کروڑ denotes exactly one crore = ten million; 'millions' is imprecise and can teach the wrong number.
مضبوط centrally means strong/sturdy/solid/firm. 'Seized' is not an appropriate core gloss and 'strong' is missing.
شدید centrally means severe/intense/strong/extreme. The current 'fast, abundant, hard/arduous' list misses the normal modern senses.
سرحد means border/frontier/boundary. 'Front-line' and 'difference/distinction' are peripheral and can confuse a learner.
پیر is a homograph meaning foot, Monday, and a spiritual guide/saint/elder. 'Old man' alone does not capture the culturally important title sense.
زر means gold/money/wealth. 'Content word' is not a POS.
